subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 116 (ALT(FT)II-10). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY, RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From INFO-DY: VT-TD (vibrational tendencies). From VT-TD: APL-DT (application dictates). From APL-DT: MOT-DY. From RT-INT-TR: PART (participation). From T-C-IMP: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: OBS (observation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
